# The repository's own guides that the corpus tests read, one path per line from the repository
# root. envoy-go and envoy-go-docs-finalizers write each one into one flat directory, under its path
# with each / as __, and point the corpus variables at it: PMDOC_ANCHOR_CORPUS,
# DISPATCH_RENDER_CORPUS and PMDOC_WALK_CORPUS (internal/dispatch/pmdoc), DISPATCH_TOKEN_CORPUS and
# DISPATCH_TEST_SPEC_CORPUS (internal/dispatch/docs). envoy-go's pmdoc differential reads them too.
#
# A guide is here only when every one of those tests can take it as a document: at most 1 MiB,
# the largest markdown document Dispatch stores (TestWriteCorpusReadsOnce seeds each one); at least
# three top-level paragraphs that hold a phrase found once (the writes of TestWriteCorpusReadsOnce);
# and at least 98 candidate sentences (the anchors of TestAMarginWriteMatchesTheWholeDocumentWrite).
# Those three rules leave out every other AGENTS.md and README.md of the repository. The one docs
# page here, docs/testing.md, took the place of scripts/dispatch/README.md when that guide fell
# below 98: of the guides the rules leave in that the list did not hold, it has the most but
# docs/kubernetes.md, which stands within a tenth of the 1 MiB and grows by that much in days.
# Both jobs' filters in .github/workflows/ci.yaml name this file and every path in it, and
# .github/scripts/ci_job_reads.py declares them as the two jobs' reads, so a change to one of these
# guides starts the jobs that read it. A path added here is a path those filters must name too.
AGENTS.md
docs/testing.md
packages/claude-envoy/README.md
packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md
packages/dispatch/README.md
packages/envoy-client/README.md
packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/AGENTS.md
packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/README.md
packages/envoy/infra/README.md
packages/envoy/loadtest/README.md
packages/envoy/scripts/README.md
packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md
packages/pi-envoy/README.md
packages/pi-legion/AGENTS.md
scripts/e2e/README.md
